## Content

- Metropolis--Hastings algorithm



## Learning objectives

At the end of the chapter, students should be able to

- implement a Metropolis--Hastings algorithm to draw samples from the posterior
- use efficient proposals and tuning for MCMC



## Readings


- Chapter [5](https://lbelzile.github.io/MATH80601A/mcmc.html) of the course notes


## Complementary readings

- @Gelman:2013, chapter 11
- @McElreath:2020, chapter 9 (non technical)
- @Neal:2003 (slice sampling)
